items.title: India-China ties better than they were last year as border standoff eases, says Indian top diplomat
items.summary: External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar said India-China relations are “better” today than they were last year, linking the improvement directly to the easing of the border standoff and stressing that the state of the border determines the state of bilateral ties.

items.title: Japan’s centenarian population tops 100,000 for first time
items.summary: The number of people who are 100 or older per population of 100,000 stood at 87.51. By prefecture, Shimane logged 186.65, marking the highest figure for the 14th consecutive year, followed by Kochi’s 169.52 and Tottori’s 152.48.

items.title: Geopolitical risks grow as world order becomes more fragmented: experts
